# Publish artifacts

1. Go to the [build summary page](https://github.com/havit/Havit.CastleWindsor.WebForms/actions/workflows/build.yml).
2. Open the latest build.
3. Download the `PublicNuGets` artifact.
4. Unzip the archive.
5. Open [Upload Package](https://www.nuget.org/packages/manage/upload) page.
6. Upload the unzipped `Havit.CastleWindsor.WebForms.*.nupkg`.
